tagline: A large, fast-growing Asian side district becoming a tech and business hub — less characterful but increasingly well-connected and affordable.

items.name: Meydan AVM Kafeler
items.description: The large Meydan shopping centre has multiple café options. The most convenient commercial hub in Ümraniye.

items.name: Ümraniye Çarşı Restoranları
items.description: A wide range of restaurants in the central market area. Very local, good value, and a genuine cross-section of Turkish cuisine.

tips: Ümraniye is on the M5 metro line — direct to Üsküdar and the Marmaray.
A growing tech and business district. Companies like Google Turkey are based here.
More affordable than the Kadıköy and Üsküdar areas with improving transport links.
Not a tourism destination but increasingly popular for long-term residential living.
